dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: That's Will and Jill. Children aren't really supposed to leave the city without an accompanying adult...

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: But I thought, they just look so happy playing together. I couldn't bring myself to go and tell them off...

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: So I've just stayed here watching them. Otherwise, I'm not sure how I'd be able to face their parents.
